logging.log_dir.description: Directory for Ironic API server log files.

logging.log_file.description: Name of the main log file (relative to log_dir or absolute path).

rpc.transport_url.description: Message broker URL for RPC communication with Conductor and other services (e.g., RabbitMQ, Qpid).

database.connection.description: Database connection string (SQLAlchemy format). Should point to a Galera cluster or single DB server.

keystone.project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project.

keystone.user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user.

keystone.project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the Ironic service user.

keystone.username.description: Username for the Ironic service account in Keystone.

keystone.password.description: Password for the Ironic service account. Required if using password auth.

service_credentials.auth_type.description: Auth method for internal service-to-service calls.

service_credentials.auth_url.description: Keystone endpoint for internal service calls.

service_credentials.project_domain_name.description: Domain for service project in internal auth.

service_credentials.user_domain_name.description: Domain for service user in internal auth.

service_credentials.project_name.description: Project name used for internal service auth.

service_credentials.username.description: Username used for internal service auth.

service_credentials.password.description: Password used for internal service auth.

service_credentials.interface.description: Keystone endpoint type (admin, internal, or public) used for service-to-service calls.

service_credentials.region_name.description: Keystone region name for service endpoints.

api.host.description: IP address or hostname the API server listens on.

api.port.description: TCP port the Ironic API server listens on.

api.workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API server. Recommended: 1–2 per CPU core.

api.max_limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per list API call.

conductor.automated_clean.description: Whether to automatically clean bare metal nodes after deployment (e.g., erase disks).

conductor.api_url.description: URL for the local Ironic API server (used by conductor for self-calls).

hardware_types.enabled.description: List of hardware types to enable (e.g., ipmi, redfish,ilo). These determine supported management protocols.

inspector.enabled.description: Enable the Ironic Inspector (hardware introspection) service integration.

inspector.auth_url.description: URL of the Ironic Inspector API (if enabled).

dns.enabled.description: Enable DNS integration for provisioned nodes (requires Neutron DNS extension).

dns.domain.description: DNS domain used for node hostname resolution.

ipmi.allow_insecure.description: Allow IPMI sessions without certificate validation (for testing only).

ipmi.remote_console_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for remote console (e.g., IPMI v2.0 RMCP+) sessions.

pxe.tftp_root.description: Directory on the TFTP server where boot images are stored.

pxe.tftp_server.description: IP address of the TFTP server serving boot images to bare metal nodes.

pxe.boot_options.description: Optional additional kernel boot parameters or PXE-specific settings.

ssl.enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for the API server.

ssl.key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file.

ssl.ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (for client auth or TLS verification).

notify.state_changes.description: List of notification levels for state change events (e.g., deploy, cleanup).

notify.notify_on_deprecation.description: Send notifications on deprecated API features (for upgrade readiness).

healthcheck.backends.description: Active healthcheck backends (controls how health endpoints behave).

options.description: Backend-specific config options as key-value pairs.

middleware.rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable global rate limiting middleware for the API.

middleware.rate_limit_burst.description: Max number of requests allowed during burst window.

middleware.rate_limit_interval.description: Window size (in seconds) for rate limiting calculations.
